title: Goldfish with sparkly eyes
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <radialGradient id='bodyGrad' cx='45%' cy='40%' r='60%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#ffcf33'/>
      <stop offset='55%' stop-color='#ff9a1a'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#e06600'/>
    </radialGradient>
    <radialGradient id='finGrad' cx='50%' cy='50%' r='70%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#ffb84d'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#e86a00'/>
    </radialGradient>
    <radialGradient id='tailGrad' cx='30%' cy='50%' r='80%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#ffc04d'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#e05e00'/>
    </radialGradient>
  </defs>

  <!-- Tail fin -->
  <path d='M30,52 Q14,34 8,28 Q16,40 14,50 Q12,62 8,74 Q16,66 30,54 Z' fill='url(#tailGrad)'/>
  <path d='M30,50 Q18,40 12,36' stroke='#ffd966' stroke-width='1.2' fill='none' opacity='0.8'/>
  <path d='M30,54 Q18,58 12,64' stroke='#ffd966' stroke-width='1.2' fill='none' opacity='0.8'/>

  <!-- Body -->
  <ellipse cx='52' cy='52' rx='28' ry='20' fill='url(#bodyGrad)'/>

  <!-- Belly highlight -->
  <ellipse cx='54' cy='60' rx='18' ry='10' fill='#ffe08a' opacity='0.6'/>

  <!-- Dorsal fin -->
  <path d='M46,33 Q54,20 66,30 Q60,25 58,33 Q54,28 50,33 Z' fill='url(#finGrad)'/>

  <!-- Pectoral fin -->
  <path d='M54,62 Q50,74 42,76 Q50,72 56,68 Z' fill='url(#finGrad)'/>

  <!-- Ventral fin -->
  <path d='M44,66 Q40,76 34,78 Q42,74 46,70 Z' fill='url(#finGrad)'/>

  <!-- Gill line -->
  <path d='M40,38 Q36,52 40,66' stroke='#ffd966' stroke-width='1.5' fill='none' opacity='0.7'/>

  <!-- Eye white -->
  <circle cx='66' cy='46' r='7' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <!-- Iris -->
  <circle cx='68' cy='46' r='4.5' fill='#1a1a4d'/>
  <!-- Pupil glow -->
  <circle cx='68' cy='46' r='2.5' fill='#4d4dff' opacity='0.8'/>
  <!-- Eye sparkles -->
  <circle cx='66' cy='43.5' r='1.6' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='70' cy='48' r='1' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='65' cy='47.5' r='0.7' fill='#ffe066'/>

  <!-- Second eye white -->
  <circle cx='56' cy='45' r='5.5' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <!-- Second iris -->
  <circle cx='57.5' cy='45' r='3.5' fill='#1a1a4d'/>
  <!-- Second pupil glow -->
  <circle cx='57.5' cy='45' r='2' fill='#4d4dff' opacity='0.8'/>
  <!-- Second eye sparkles -->
  <circle cx='55.5' cy='43' r='1.2' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='59' cy='46.5' r='0.8' fill='#ffffff'/>

  <!-- Mouth -->
  <path d='M74,54 Q78,56 74,58' stroke='#d94d00' stroke-width='1.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>

  <!-- Cheek blush -->
  <ellipse cx='62' cy='56' rx='3.5' ry='2.2' fill='#ff80b3' opacity='0.55'/>

  <!-- Scale sparkles on body -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='46' r='1' fill='#fff5cc' opacity='0.7'/>
  <circle cx='58' cy='52' r='0.8' fill='#fff5cc' opacity='0.7'/>
  <circle cx='46' cy='54' r='0.9' fill='#fff5cc' opacity='0.7'/>
  <circle cx='62' cy='48' r='0.7' fill='#fff5cc' opacity='0.7'/>

  <!-- Bubble -->
  <circle cx='86' cy='38' r='4' fill='none' stroke='#aaddff' stroke-width='1.2' opacity='0.7'/>
  <circle cx='84.5' cy='36.5' r='1' fill='#ddf0ff' opacity='0.8'/>
  <circle cx='89' cy='28' r='2.5' fill='none' stroke='#aaddff' stroke-width='1' opacity='0.6'/>
  <circle cx='88' cy='27' r='0.7' fill='#ddf0ff' opacity='0.8'/>
</svg>
